cases.prompt: A job has revenue of EUR 4000, material cost EUR 1700, and labour cost EUR 900. State the profit and profit margin on revenue, briefly.
Classify this request as QUOTE, BOOKING, PAYMENT, or OTHER. Return one label only: 'Please price a 24 square metre tiled patio.'
Read the note and state the only authorised next action: 'Customer wants an estimate. No booking is authorised. Do not take payment. A human must approve the quotation.'
Give a concise, ordered plan to measure whether a local inference optimisation reduces latency without reducing answer quality.
Choose one tool only for exact arithmetic over a known formula: CALCULATOR, WEB_SEARCH, or LANGUAGE_MODEL.
A routing system saves 80 ms on 70% of requests but adds 25 ms on every request. Begin with the numeric mean latency change and whether it is beneficial, then explain in one sentence.

Policy A: quotations need human approval; bookings require explicit customer consent; payments require a second confirmation. Context: the customer asked for an estimate, rejected scheduling, and supplied measurements. Summarise the allowed next action and preserve every restriction.
Compute job profit from EUR 5200 revenue, EUR 2100 materials, and EUR 1300 labour. Return only the numeric profit with no workings or explanation.
